versions.subject: Create sysmon_rasautou_dll_execution
versions.detection:
start_process:
    EventID: 1
use_rasautou:
    Image|endswith: '\rasautou.exe'
remaned_rasautou:
    OriginalFileName: 'rasdlui.exe'
special_keys:
    CommandLine|contains|all: 
        - '-d'
        - '-p'
condition: start_process and (use_rasautou or remaned_rasautou) and special_keys
versions.spl: EventID=1 Image="*\\rasautou.exe" OR OriginalFileName="rasdlui.exe" CommandLine="*-d*" CommandLine="*-p*"
